title: Rune, Havoc integrate logistics software with autonomous aircraft | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies and Havoc demonstrated integrated autonomous logistics by connecting TyrOS planning software with autonomous aircraft for resupply operations in communications-limited tactical environments.
body_markdown:
Militart+Aerospace Electronics covered Rune Technologies by Jamie Whitney in a piece titled “Rune, Havoc integrate logistics software with autonomous aircraft.” Rune Technologies and Havoc demonstrated integrated autonomous logistics by connecting TyrOS planning software with autonomous aircraft for resupply operations in communications-limited tactical environments.


Read the full article[here](https://www.militaryaerospace.com/uncrewed/article/55404561/rune-havoc-integrate-logistics-software-with-autonomous-aircraft) .
